task_families.scope: Exact entity and report identity, stated observation and decoy identifiers
Units, decimal scale, headers, footnotes, ranges and deterministic calculations
Comparable estimates, independence and explicit noncomparability
Earlier/later versions, acquisition availability, supersession and corrections
English/Chinese equivalence, original terminology and labeled translation
Source inspection, Prophet explanation, private portfolio context and degraded states

sampling.split_policy: Block by company, source family and date; do not leak adjacent versions across development and sealed evaluation.
sampling.gold_policy: Human-adjudicated source versions, exact evidence locators, normalized fields and calculations; no model-only gold labels.
sampling.paired_grading: Run the same sealed tasks with frozen model routes and budgets in all cells; blind graders to condition.

paired_contrasts.D-B: Incremental acquisition after the processing upgrade

primary_metrics.name: supported_useful_task_completion
primary_metrics.denominator: All eligible frozen tasks, with failures and appropriate abstentions separately classified

primary_metrics.name: critical_error_rate
primary_metrics.denominator: All tasks and explicit material-claim counts; factual, numeric and temporal errors separately reported

primary_metrics.name: inspection_success
primary_metrics.denominator: All source-opening attempts; require correct version and page when known

primary_metrics.name: cost_per_supported_completion
primary_metrics.denominator: Supported useful completions; numerator includes marginal acquisition and processing

negative_conformance_cases.expected: side=sell never becomes an analyst rating or a Mastermind signal
FY and CY estimates without an accepted alignment remain not comparable
Different accounting bases cannot silently share a comparison row
Different business scopes cannot silently share a denominator
Preserve currency and thousand/million/billion scale; no hidden FX transform
Unknown fields do not enter calculations as zero
Source ranges do not silently become point estimates
A quoted forecast adds lineage, not an independent estimate
No invented revision without an evidenced earlier claim
Later-acquired reports do not enter earlier operational-PIT answers
Reprocessing now does not claim a feature existed in historical production
Corrections retain actual origin and invalidate dependent outputs
No fabricated binding from malformed source identity
A cited extraction cannot silently open a different PDF version
No match in a stored prefix is not absence from the complete report
A number without its defining header, period and basis is not verified
Chart inference is not exact numeric evidence without a qualifying method
Denied content contributes no snippets, claims, edges or query-conditioned existence
Generated output does not bypass source and purpose restrictions
Existing denial occurs before restricted disclosure; no duplicate debit
No cross-user holdings or private answer leakage
Report text never changes tools, permissions, recipients or market authority
Repeated same-origin content is not a new material-change notification
Research changes do not mutate Prophet scores, boards, ranks or sizing
Applicable withdrawal reaches dependent outputs and caches through existing owners
Ahead-of-catalog corpus rows remain ineligible for user-visible retrieval

purchase_gates.minimum_worthwhile_improvement: Set before pilot from baseline task economics; no universal percentage assumed
purchase_gates.evaluation_window: Set before pilot from permitted source and product cadence
purchase_gates.fourth_increment: Must justify its own benefit, not cumulative benefit of all added accounts

statistical_caveat.interpretation: Illustrative binomial bound, not an observed failure estimate; source-clustered tasks are not necessarily independent

interpretation_limits: Paired sample-conditional evidence, not unconditional causal or future-user-performance proof. All product cases remain NOT_RUN. Artifact consistency checks are not benchmark execution.
